title: I remembered the name of a bar!
content: I was downtown and there was some sort of party going on at a bar. I finally remembered the name of it. The name of the bar was "Bananas". It was like a brown entrance and there were people there in like more of a '90s and early 2000s attire. I'm not going to lie. It was pretty bumping. Lol has anybody else heard of this place or been here? Does anybody remember names?
